output.explanation: The PayPal API host was a hardcoded sandbox URL in paypal.js, so going live meant editing source, and it was easy to ship sandbox to production or point tests at live. The base URL is now read from the PAYPAL_API_BASE environment variable and falls back to the sandbox host when it is unset, so local and test setups behave exactly as before. Every request already builds its URL from `base`, so nothing else needed to change.
output.notes: In production, set PAYPAL_API_BASE=https://api-m.paypal.com alongside live PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID and PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET. Left unset, the app keeps using the sandbox. The hardcoded credential fallbacks on the lines above are a separate finding and were not touched in this patch.
